_comment: Everyday setup: ONE entry, no MAME, PID, launch.json or run directory needed. Register with: claude mcp add mame --scope user -e "MAMEMCP_MAME_DIR=D:\arcade\mame" -e "MAMEMCP_ROMPATH=D:\arcade\ROMs\MAME 0.289 ROMs (merged)" -- <repo>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -I -m mame_mcp.server . The game is started later, explicitly, with the start_session tool. Optional: MAMEMCP_RUNS_DIR. This file is a reference, nothing reads it.
